headline: Junk Warrior
title: Junk Warrior Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Junk Warrior. What is it? It is a Level five DARK Warrior Synchro Monster with two thousand three hundred attack, used by Yusei. What does it do? When Synchro Summoned it gains attack equal to the total attack of all Level two or lower monsters you control. How do you use it? Its materials are Junk Synchron plus non-Tuners, and Junk Synchron can revive a Level two or lower monster when Normal Summoned. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
